heading: The Twelve Disciples Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Twelve Disciples Bible crossword: Peter, James and John, Thomas, Matthew the publican and the rest. KJV clues from Mark 3, free on iOS.
prose: He goes up into a mountain, calls whom he would, and ordains twelve that they should be with him. The Twelve Disciples is a grid of names and the details attached to them — the sons of thunder, the fisherman renamed a stone, the publican called from the receipt of custom, the one who wanted to see the print of the nails.
Names make unusually satisfying crossword answers because they cross well and they stick. The closing verse is the ordaining itself.

clues.text: Simon, whom he surnamed a stone

verseText: And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,
